verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API, but the evidence never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The CLI's "live self-describing contract" and the llms.txt file are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
